template.$comment: The one master every Open and Enrolling card is generated from (QC loop repair plan 2026-09-25, repair 5). source is the file Yash supplies (an APEX asset id or a path under tests/fixtures is fine); format is svg or png+layout; null = not supplied yet, so nothing can be generated for production and every missing card stays a Missing Info ask to the owner. The generator is agent/generate-open-card.mjs, the only production path is protocols/recipes/open-card.md, and the fixture is a plain placeholder for the tests, never a card for a page.
template.ask: Yash: please supply the Open and Enrolling card master with the campus name replaced by the literal text {{CAMPUS}}, as an SVG export of the design (fonts outlined or embedded; preferred), or as the flat PNG without the name plus the name's text layout (x, y baseline, font, size, colour, max width, alignment) in template pixels. Attach it to the card batch ticket in APEX or post it in #support-websites. The agent then generates each campus's card with agent/generate-open-card.mjs (protocols/recipes/open-card.md), you approve the first three generated cards, and only then is any card placed.
